# MDRS-106 — the medrese layer: medrese, köşk affiliation, nazır membership

Decision record: [ADR-003](../adr/003-medrese-layer.md). The code lives in
tedrisat (ADR-003 §D2).

## What was done

**Schema (migration `0017_madrasahs`, generated by drizzle-kit).**

- `madrasahs`: `id`, `handle` (unique, not null), `name`, `description`,
  `cover_hue` (default 215), `created_by`, `created_at`, `updated_at`.
- `madrasah_nazirs`: `madrasah_id` (FK, `ON DELETE CASCADE`), `user_id`,
  `created_at`; primary key `(madrasah_id, user_id)`.
- `kosks.madrasah_id`: nullable FK to `madrasahs.id`, `ON DELETE SET NULL`.

The reversal is `apps/tedrisat/src/database/rollbacks/0017_madrasahs.down.sql`.
drizzle's migrator only moves forward, so it is applied by hand, followed by
deleting 0017's row from `drizzle.__drizzle_migrations`.

**Endpoints (`MadrasahController`, all behind `AuthGuard` + `AuthzGuard`, each
with `@Authz`).**

| Route | Scope | Who passes |
| -- | -- | -- |
| `GET /madrasahs`, `GET /madrasahs/:id` | `VIEW` | anyone signed in |
| `POST /madrasahs` | `CREATE_MADRASAH` | SYSTEM_ADMIN (no row grants it) |
| `PATCH /madrasahs/:id` | `EDIT` | nazır |
| `DELETE /madrasahs/:id` | `DELETE` | SYSTEM_ADMIN (removed from the nazır row, MDRS-124) |
| `POST` / `DELETE /madrasahs/:id/nazirs/:userId` | `INVITE_NAZIR` / `REMOVE_NAZIR` | nazır |
| `POST` / `DELETE /madrasahs/:id/kosks/:koskId` | `MANAGE_KOSK` | nazır |

A missing or malformed medrese id answers 404 before the matrix is consulted
(the controller's `byExistingMadrasah` resolver). A taken handle is 409
`MADRASAH_HANDLE_TAKEN`; affiliating a köşk that belongs to another medrese is
409 `KOSK_ALREADY_AFFILIATED`; detaching a köşk that is not this medrese's is
404 `KOSK_NOT_AFFILIATED`; removing a user who is not a nazır is 404
`MADRASAH_NAZIR_NOT_FOUND`. Inviting an existing nazır again is a no-op.

**Resolver (`TedrisatRoleResolver`).** `madrasah` → `MADRASAH_NAZIR` when the
caller is in `madrasah_nazirs`, else `PUBLIC` (the `TODO(authz)` is gone for
medrese; it stays for ijazah). `kosk` → `KOSK_MANAGER` for the owner,
`MADRASAH_NAZIR` for a nazır of the köşk's medrese, else `PUBLIC`; the owner
check and the nazır check run in parallel. `course` is unchanged: a nazır gets
nothing on a course from being a nazır.

**Matrix.** `DELETE` removed from `MATRIX.madrasah.MADRASAH_NAZIR`; the two
`MADRASAH_NAZIR` rows (köşk, medrese) are no longer marked UNREACHABLE (7 of
19 rows remain so).

**Köşk.** Every köşk read (`GET /kosks`, `GET /kosks/:id`, and the köşk
returned by the affiliation routes) carries `madrasahId` and
`madrasah: { id, name, handle } | null`. `PATCH /kosks/:id` moved from the
service's owner check to `@Authz(SCOPES.EDIT, …)` with a method-level
`AuthzGuard`, so that the nazır's `EDIT` comes from the matrix; a missing köşk
is still 404, a non-owner still 403 (now `AUTHZ_FORBIDDEN` instead of
`KOSK_FORBIDDEN`). The köşk's other handlers keep their owner checks.

**Leaving a medrese (review finding).** `DELETE /kosks/:id/madrasah`
(`@Authz(SCOPES.EDIT)` on the köşk) makes a köşk standalone again. Without it
the köşk's own manager — `PUBLIC` on the medrese — had no way out of an
affiliation a nazır made; only that medrese's nazırs could detach it. 404
`KOSK_NOT_AFFILIATED` when the köşk has no medrese.

**Client.** Spec and typed client regenerated (`pnpm run openapi:tedrisat`):
new `MadrasahsApi` and five models, `KoskResponse` gains the two fields.
Generated files whose only change was the document-version header were left
untouched, as in MDRS-95/104. The new API is not wired into
`libs/services`' `api` object — MDRS-107 builds the screens that call it.

## What was verified

- `nx affected -t typecheck test build lint module-boundaries --base=da49bef`:
  green for tedrisat, teskilat, common, services, nizam-web, tedris-web and
  their dependencies. tedrisat: 29 suites, 463 tests, 0 failures (from the
  run's `coverage/junit.xml`).
- `test/e2e/madrasah.e2e.spec.ts` (real `AuthGuard`, minted tokens):
  only SYSTEM_ADMIN creates (a nazır, a köşk manager and a stranger get 403 and
  no row is written); taken handle 409; bad handle 400; anyone lists and reads;
  unknown / malformed id 404; a nazır edits, a stranger gets 403; a nazır
  affiliates and detaches a köşk, a stranger and the köşk's own manager get
  403; a köşk of another medrese is 409 to take and 404 to detach; the köşk's
  manager leaves the medrese with `DELETE /kosks/:id/madrasah` (a stranger
  gets 403, a second call 404); invite and
  remove nazırs, the invitee can then edit; a nazır gets 403 on
  `DELETE /madrasahs/:id`, SYSTEM_ADMIN deletes and the köşk survives with
  `madrasah_id` null and the nazır rows gone; a nazır gets `EDIT` on an
  affiliated köşk, 403 on a köşk outside their medrese, 403 on
  `DELETE /kosks/:id`, and 403 on `PATCH /courses/:id`,
  `POST /courses/:id/weeks/:weekId/lessons`, `PATCH /lessons/:id` and
  `DELETE /lessons/:id` of that köşk's course.
- `test/e2e/madrasah-migration.e2e.spec.ts`: applies 0000–0016 by hand, writes
  a köşk, applies 0017 — the köşk row is identical apart from a null
  `madrasah_id` — then the down script — both tables and the column are gone
  and the köşk row equals its pre-0017 self — then 0017 again.
- `test/unit/authz/tedrisat-role-resolver.spec.ts`: `MADRASAH_NAZIR` for a
  medrese nazır and for a nazır of the köşk's medrese (each fails if its
  branch is removed); manager wins over nazır on a köşk; a nazır stays
  `PUBLIC` on a course and the medrese is not consulted there.
- `libs/common/test/authz/auth-matrix.spec.ts`: no medrese row grants
  `DELETE` or `CREATE_MADRASAH`; the nazır's köşk scopes are a subset of the
  manager's and exclude `DELETE`.
- `node tools/ci/assert-openapi-spec-fresh.mjs`: green (44 paths).

## What was not verified

- The down script against a database that production traffic has written
  medrese rows into; it drops them, which is what a rollback means here.
- Anything in the web apps: no screen calls the new API yet (MDRS-107).

## Follow-up

- **Consent for affiliation.** A nazır can bind any standalone köşk without its
  manager agreeing, and then holds `EDIT` and `MANAGE_COURSES` on it until the
  manager leaves with `DELETE /kosks/:id/madrasah`. The issue
  asks for exactly this; whether a request/accept step is wanted is a product
  decision (ADR-003, Negative consequences).
- **Hiding a medrese** is MDRS-124's `archived_at` work; until then a nazır has
  no way to take their medrese down.
- **`GET /me` `nazirOf`** is still `[]`, and nazırs still cannot use
  `GET /users`; both were left for MDRS-107 by MDRS-104 and can now read
  `madrasah_nazirs`.
- **Removing the last nazır** is allowed; the medrese then has only
  SYSTEM_ADMIN to govern it.
- `madrasah_nazirs` has no index on `user_id` alone and `kosks.madrasah_id`
  none at all; every query this change adds filters on the leading primary-key
  column or on `kosks.id`. Add them when "medreses I govern" or "köşks of a
  medrese" lists appear.
